about: Exercise library. Edit any field. minLevel is the lowest level an exercise may be used at. groups lists the client groups it suits. Each exercise has a source: jay, research or assumption. Spring colors come from equipment.json and are assumptions.

fieldNotes.equipment: Station id from equipment.json: reformer, box, chair, mat, bosu, springboard or standing.
fieldNotes.blocks: Block ids from class-types.json that this exercise fits.
fieldNotes.minLevel: Lowest class level that may use it: 1, 1.5, 2 or 2.5.
fieldNotes.spinalFlexion: none, light (small curl) or deep (loaded curl like teaser or roll up).
fieldNotes.floor: true if the client is down on the floor.
fieldNotes.springs: Spring id from the station in equipment.json.
fieldNotes.minutes: min, typical and max minutes the generator may give it.
fieldNotes.prepares: Joints and movement patterns this exercise warms up, used to build toward a peak pose.
fieldNotes.pose: Plain description of the position, used for the image prompt.
fieldNotes.family: Similar exercises share a family. The generator avoids too many from one family.
